name: DiT Diffusion Transformer
description: Noisy patches in, predicted noise out

data.noteContent:
A diffusion model is trained to look at a noisy image and say which part of it is noise. DiT does that with a Transformer instead of a U-Net: patch the latent, attend globally over the patches, project back. Every patch can consult every other one from layer one, where a U-Net has to pool its way to that reach.

Two things a real DiT conditions on are not wired here: the timestep and the prompt, which enter through adaptive layer norm in the paper. The input is a random tensor, so what comes out is a guess about noise from noise - the graph shows the wiring and the shapes.

擴散模型學的是看著一張帶噪的影像，指出其中哪一部分是噪聲。DiT 用 Transformer 取代 U-Net 來做這件事：把 latent 切成 patch、讓 patch 之間做全域注意力、再投影回去。每個 patch 從第一層就能參考其他所有 patch，U-Net 則要靠一路池化才有同樣的視野。

真正的 DiT 會條件化的兩件事沒有接進來：時間步和提示詞，論文是從 adaptive layer norm 進去的。輸入是隨機張量，所以輸出等於是從噪聲猜噪聲 — 這張圖看的是接線與形狀。

The input is already a latent, 4 channels at 8x8, about the size a VAE would leave. A stride-2 patch of it gives a 4x4 grid: 16 tokens of 64 dims, and that is the whole sequence the Transformer sees.

輸入本身就是 latent：4 個通道、8x8，差不多是 VAE 壓完的大小。對它做 stride 2 的切塊會得到 4x4 的格點：16 個 64 維 token，這就是 Transformer 看到的全部序列。

out_features 64 is per patch: each token is projected back to a patch-sized noise prediction. A full model would fold those into the latent grid and subtract one step of noise.

out_features 64 是「每個 patch」的：每個 token 被投影回一塊 patch 大小的噪聲預測。完整的模型會把它們折回 latent 格點，再減掉一步噪聲。
